# Amber Student

> > Amber is a global student housing platform simplifying accommodation booking for international students in the UK, Australia, and beyond.

Amber Student connects students with verified housing options across major cities including London, Glasgow, Liverpool, Edinburgh, Sheffield, and Melbourne. The platform offers services like group bookings, 24/7 support, and cashback programs through Amber Plus.
